value.account: Two defects. (1) orchestrator/workflow/validation.py _validate_repeat_until_on_exhausted: the 'may only override scalar' relpath rejection ran before the check for the exact compiler-emitted generated ref (the 2.29+ inactive-variant placeholder). I moved the generated-ref check first; it is only honored when the compiler sets allow_generated_repeat_until_on_exhausted_refs and the ref equals the captured one, so authored relpath overrides (and literals) are still rejected (existing tests/test_loader_validation.py case still passes). (2) Once compiled, exhaustion failed at runtime on 2.29+: on_exhausted ref overrides were stored raw ({'ref':...}) in the loop frame, and the 2.29+ union match join reads result__* from the loop (2.28 read state__* directly), so the join saw a dict and failed contract validation (this hit non-path fields like rounds too). In orchestrator/workflow/loops.py repeat_until_exhaustion_artifacts now resolves ref overrides (frame's own artifacts, else state via _resolve_ref_value) for workflow version >= 2.29 only; 2.28 and earlier are untouched, and join output contract validation is unchanged so malformed values still fail. Tests: tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_paths.py runs a union loop with a path field at 2.28/2.29/2.32 for done and exhausted paths. Ran that plus loop_recur, loops_exhaustion_state, rich_loop_values_e2e, scoped_union_guards, loader_validation, executor_characterization: 358 passed. Dry-run of bugs/loop_result_paths program at 2.32 compiles. Considered: relaxing the join to resolve ref dicts (rejected: would accept ref-shaped values from any step output), and emitting literals instead of placeholder refs in lowering (rejected: changes 2.29+ lowering shape other tests pin). Not covered: did not run the full suite or real provider runs of the bug program; unresolvable refs are left raw (previous behaviour) rather than failing at exhaustion; resume of a run persisted before the fix is not examined.
value.summary: Loop results with path fields in non-exhausted union variants now compile and run at 2.29-2.32 as at 2.28, via a validator fix for compiler-emitted exhaustion placeholder refs and a runtime fix that resolves exhaustion ref overrides.
